purpose: Repair the existing active-work animation to reduce gesture jumps and improve clarity at native 192x208 size.

visual_review.identity: Same silver-white/lavender chibi dragon woman; purple eyes; white horns; viewer-right rosette; matching dress, wings, and attached tail.
visual_review.scale_baseline: Planting and dress hem remain stable across six frames; no locomotion or abrupt resize.
visual_review.state_semantics: Right fingertip stays at chin through the entire focused thinking loop; lowered eyelids in central phases convey concentration.
visual_review.motion_continuity: Open eyes transition through slight lowering and recovery; first and last poses nearly coincide. No chin-to-temple hand switch, large closed-eye frame, wing pose flip, or large body gesture.
visual_review.native_clarity: Purple irises, lashes, horn outlines and ruffle edges are readable at 192x208. Fine violet-grey linework preserves pastel anime style; no thick black border.
visual_review.effects_connectivity: No props, labels, detached effects, shadows or clipping.
visual_review.remaining_cleanup: Extracted native cells have residual green edge spill. Parent must run prescribed single final atlas despill after assembly; source art otherwise passes.
